dynamic_line.yes: Ooh, I like telling this one!  So it was a cold sunday morning when I heard just the loudest banging on the front door of my apartment.  But I was prepared! Unfortunately I did live on the third floor, so I definitely sprained something.  But besides that, I then ran straight into the woods, so them damn zombies couldn't track my scent or something.
